description_html:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Social Media Director - 4 month FTC - part-time

This is a senior leadership opportunity to shape and lead social media strategy and execution for a global domestic appliances brand, spanning categories including air fryers, vacuum cleaners, and coffee machines. 

Based within a newly established global in‑house studio in Amsterdam, this role sits at the heart of the brand's digital transformation. The studio operates with the speed and creative ambition of an agency, combined with the strategic depth and scale of an in‑house team, delivering social‑first strategy, content, and influencer activity across global and local markets. 

As Social Media Director, you will define how the brand shows up across platforms, creators, and communities worldwide - setting the vision, building high‑performing teams, and ensuring social delivers meaningful brand and business impact. You will be a key driver of social‑first thinking, innovation, and the integration of Generative AI across strategy, content, and operations. 

ABOUT YOU 

We're looking for a highly accomplished, digitally fluent social media and influencer leader with 10+ years' experience, ideally gained within agency or hybrid in‑house environments. 

You are a strategic thinker with a strong commercial mindset, proven experience managing complex global stakeholders, and a passion for the power of social media and influencer marketing to drive growth. You bring a deep understanding of platform dynamics, evolving social behaviours, creator ecosystems, and emerging technologies (particularly Generative AI) and know how to translate these insights into scalable, impactful solutions. 

You are an inspiring, collaborative leader, comfortable managing and mentoring large, multidisciplinary teams, influencing senior stakeholders, and building modern ways of working. You are data‑driven, creatively ambitious, and deeply attuned to what makes brands and consumers connect in today's fast‑moving digital landscape. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Leadership & Team Management 

  • Lead, coach, and inspire social and influencer teams to deliver best‑in‑class, social‑first work 
  • Provide line management to senior social and influencer leads, partnering closely with Creative, Strategy, Production, and Performance leadership 
  • Build a strong, future‑ready social capability within the studio, fostering collaboration, innovation, and excellence 
  • Act as the senior social point of contact for client stakeholders, guiding vision and decision‑making 
  • Drive year‑on‑year growth against agreed KPIs, managing complex stakeholder relationships effectively 

Strategy & Client Partnership 

  • Own the global social vision for the brand, enabling local relevance at scale 
  • Oversee the development of comprehensive social and influencer strategies, informed by insight, performance data, and AI‑powered analytics 
  • Provide senior‑level social consultancy to client leadership, producing clear strategy frameworks and playbooks 
  • Build trusted, long‑term client relationships and proactively respond to evolving business needs 
  • Contribute to the development of innovative proposals and new opportunities within the account 

Operational Excellence & Innovation 

  • Establish and embed best practices, processes, and ways of working that drive operational efficiency and creative quality 
  • Ensure teams maintain deep platform expertise and social‑first thinking across all work 
  • Direct social and influencer output across global and regional markets 
  • Champion measurement, effectiveness, and performance‑led optimisation 
  • Educate stakeholders on the role of social in building brands and driving measurable outcomes 

Innovation & Technology

description_html:

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we’re looking for

  • 10+ years of years experience, shipping websites and landing pages users genuinely love

  • Portfolio demonstrating landing pages and advanced web interactions (if you don’t have a portfolio of landing pages - check out our other roles)

  • Ability to make smart trade-offs between speed and polish, knowing when to ship and when to refine

  • Strong fundamental understanding of modern frontend systems - React architecture, state management, performance, accessibility, and scalable UI patterns

  • Experience translating scrappy explorations into production-ready experiences

  • Strong design sense with an eye for detail, accessibility, and usability

  • Ideally - you push the boundaries of the web with technologies like WebGL

What you’ll do

In one sentence: Own and elevate landing pages and web experiences that help share Lovable with the world.

  • Build landing pages that delight, also designing interactions or pairing closely with designers

  • Implement web interactions in React/TypeScript with obsessive attention to performance, responsiveness, and cross-browser consistency

  • Drive front-end execution - pioneering new interaction patterns, micro-animations, and delightful details that elevate the entire experience

  • Collaborate with marketing, helping share Lovable with the world

  • Explore and iterate on visual designs with designers, translating explorations into scalable, web-native implementations

  • Build and maintain reusable components that enhance consistency while enabling creativity across both product and marketing

  • Reinvent how teams build for the web

Our tech stack

We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:

  • Frontend: React, Tailwind

  • Backend: Golang and Rust

  • Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Many LLM providers

  • DevOps & Tooling: Github Actions, Grafana, OTEL, , infra-as-code (Terraform)

And always on the lookout for what's next!

How we hire

  1. Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call with recruiter.

  2. Show us some of your work you’re really proud of.

  3. Show us how you approach problems during several technical interviews, including a technical screening where we evaluate frontend engineering fundamentals at the same level we expect from Product Engineers.

  4. In some cases, we may opt to do paid, trial work.

About your application

  • Please submit your application in English - it’s our company language so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join

  • We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal

  • For this role, we're prioritising candidates based in New York

title: IT Support Lead

description_html:
About Parity

Parity is one of the world’s most experienced companies building the core infrastructure behind blockchain — the system that allows information and value to be shared securely without needing an intermediary. We’re laying the foundation for a better web which respects the freedom and data of individuals, and empowers developers to build better, more trustworthy online services.

Our remote-first, global team develops open-source software that anyone can use or improve. This includes Polkadot, Polkadot SDK, and Kusama — key parts of the Web3 tech stack, the next generation of the internet. Our mission is to make Polkadot the most active and innovative community in blockchain, powering a new era of connected and decentralised applications.

People in our collective are:

  • Highly motivated to contribute to Parity’s mission and be part of something bigger

  • Excited to work on projects that are groundbreaking and complex

  • Autonomous, but also collaborate well with others

  • Take maximum accountability and have minimum ego at work

  • Comfortable with chaos and adapting to the ever-changing Web3 space

  • Continuously educating themselves about Parity and the wider Polkadot ecosystem

About the Team
We're looking for an IT Support Lead to level up how we deliver IT services across a remote-first, global organisation. You'll be a part of the Operations & Culture team and manage one End User Support Engineer. You'll act as the technical escalation point, and drive smarter, more automated ways of working, both within IT and for the tools we bring to the rest of the company.

This is a hands-on management role: you'll coach and grow your team while staying close enough to the work to support end users and spot where AI and automation can remove friction, and where our procurement processes need a sharper eye.

What you’ll do

Team management

  • Manage and mentor our End User Support Specialist, setting clear priorities and supporting their growth.

  • Own the day-to-day coordination of support tickets from creation to resolution, and act as the escalation point for complex or high-stakes issues, bringing enough technical depth to help identify root causes and permanent fixes.

  • Get hands-on with end user support yourself, troubleshooting issues directly and role-modelling a strong service and support orientation for the team. This will be a significant part of your day-to-day.

  • Build a high-performance, data-oriented culture within IT support.

AI & automation

  • Support the adoption of AI and automation across IT support workflows, from ticket triage to recurring processes, so the team works efficiently and spends less time on repetitive tasks.

  • Proactively identify new tools and approaches to deliver more efficient, cost-effective IT support as the business evolves.

  • Apply automation to your own processes and reporting where it makes sense.

IT procurement & vendor management

  • Own IT procurement from vendor selection to ongoing relationship management.

  • Handle individual laptop and hardware purchases for new hires in hard-to-reach or logistically complex countries, drawing on real expertise in sourcing and international delivery to make sure equipment arrives reliably and on time. This is a regular, recurring part of the role given how distributed our team is.

  • Set up regular monitoring and auditing of vendor and provider performance to ensure quality, reliability, and value for money.

  • Develop new procurement approaches suited to a remote-first company sourcing hardware and services across many countries, including markets where procurement is traditionally difficult.

Systems & operations

  • Manage and monitor the reliable delivery and performance of core IT systems against agreed BAU standards.

  • Ensure seamless IT onboarding and offboarding across our global team.

  • Communicate incidents and resolution plans clearly with third-party vendors and service providers.

  • Collaborate with SRE, Security, and Workplace teams to support IT security, compliance, and reliability.

Your skills

  • 5+ years of experience in IT support or IT operations, including experience managing or mentoring a team.

  • Comfortable using AI tools to automate workflows and improve support processes, and genuinely curious about applying this further.

  • Experience with user access management in a fast-moving, multi-SaaS environment.

  • Experience with MDM and EDR products.

  • Strong understanding of LAN and WLAN logical and physical infrastructures, from structured cabling to network device management, which includes access layer switches, firewalls, and access points. Experience with different network vendors is a plus.

  • You have knowledge of Linux (desktop and server) and Mac operating systems to be comfortable and sure when supporting end users.

  • Familiarity with on premise server hardware and operations, from minimal to moderate complexity.

  • Confident on the command line interface - both in Linux and Mac environments. Scripting skills or automation experiences is a plus.

  • Understanding of how software development teams work and the tools they typically rely on.

  • A solutions-oriented mindset, system-thinking abilities, comfortable working cross-functionally to get things done.

  • Financial discipline: you know exactly where every euro goes.

  • Passion and good knowledge of common Open Source Software products

  • English proficiency at C1 level or native speaker.

About working with us

  • Competitive remuneration packages based on iterative market research, including tokens (where legally possible)

  • “Future of work” environment that’s remote-first and self-initiating with flexible hours

  • Team mates that are genuinely excited about their impact and projects

  • Access to the brightest minds in this space to learn about Web3 and develop your skills and knowledge while on the job

  • Becoming part of the wider ecosystem (career and networking opportunities)

  • Team and company-wide retreats

  • Work laptop

Joining Parity means joining team mates who are genuinely excited about the impact their projects are having, and the opportunity to grow alongside some of the brightest minds in the Web3 space! You’ll work remotely and flexibly, while still getting to meet your team mates throughout the year at team and company-wide retreats.

Upon receiving an offer, all candidates undergo a background check through Zinc, our trusted third-party provider. Team members will be taken on as a contractor via our UK entity. View our Applicant Notice to see how we use your data.

Parity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome diversity in our global team and care about everyone in our collective feeling included and welcome

Is this position not quite your match? Browse our other open roles.

Volta is building AI-ready data centre infrastructure across the UK, Norway, Germany, Spain and the US, and is preparing for a US public listing as a foreign private issuer following a Series A led by a16z and Altimeter. Getting our external reporting infrastructure ready - US GAAP financial statements, SEC-standard disclosures and input to the supporting close processes - is one of the finance function's defining projects over the next 12 to 16 months.

As SEC Reporting Manager you will build and run the external reporting process: preparing US GAAP consolidated financial statements and footnotes, drafting disclosures to SEC standard, and constructing the supporting evidence and tie-out discipline expected of a registrant. You will work directly with the Director of Technical Accounting and the VP Accounting and be central to the F-1 preparation and the first audited financial statements.

This is a build role, not a maintain role - you will create the reporting calendar, the disclosure checklists and the tie-out packs from scratch and see them through a first-year Big Four audit into a live registration statement.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Prepare US GAAP consolidated financial statements, including full footnote disclosures, for audit and ultimately SEC filing

  • Build and maintain the disclosure checklist and reporting calendar across annual and interim cycles

  • Draft SEC-standard disclosures (F-1/20-F sections, MD&A support) working with the Director of Technical Accounting and the VP of Accounting, as well as the wider team

  • Own the tie-out process: every number in the statements agreed to support, referenced and reviewable

  • Manage the consolidation and FX translation (ASC 830) mechanics feeding the statements

  • Coordinate audit deliverables and respond to auditor requests through fieldwork and completion

  • Prepare statutory bridge outputs for UK filing requirements alongside the US GAAP statements

  • Implement reporting tools (disclosure management/XBRL readiness) as the function matures

  • Support quarterly reporting design ahead of public-company cadence

What You Bring

  • Qualified accountant (ACA/CPA or equivalent) with 5+ years' experience including financial statement preparation under US GAAP

  • Hands-on experience drafting or auditing SEC filings (10-K, 20-F, F-1/S-1) - registrant or Big Four

  • Strong command of US GAAP disclosure requirements and consolidation, including foreign currency translation

  • Meticulous tie-out and documentation discipline

  • Experience working with external auditors through year-end reporting cycles

The Statutory Reporting Manager owns statutory financial reporting across Volta's group — a fast-growing set of holding, operating, and financing entities spanning the UK, US, Norway, Luxembourg, and Spain. As the group adds entities and jurisdictions at pace, you will make sure every legal entity meets its local statutory reporting obligations accurately, on time, and to a standard that holds up under audit and investor scrutiny.

Working closely with the Corporate Secretary, external auditors, and local advisors in each jurisdiction, you will own the full statutory reporting cycle — from local GAAP/IFRS preparation through audit management to filing — while building the processes that let this function scale as the entity count grows.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own the USGAAP to IFRS bridge

  • Own preparation and filing of statutory financial statements across all group entities and jurisdictions

  • Manage the external audit process for statutory accounts, coordinating with auditors and local advisors

  • Ensure compliance with local GAAP/IFRS requirements and statutory filing deadlines across the UK, US, Norway, Luxembourg, and Spain

  • Partner with the Corporate Secretary on entity management, ensuring statutory reporting aligns with the group's entity structure and filing calendars

description_html:
About Freetrade

Freetrade’s mission is to become the default place to invest. Investing has been too complicated and expensive for too long, keeping millions from making the most of their savings.

We’re changing that.

We’re building our team and looking for people who are excited to reshape how our customers invest and grow their wealth. If you’re driven by solving complex problems and building innovative products, you’ll fit right in.

2026 is a big year for us. Last year, we announced a game changing deal to become part of the IG Group. We’ll continue to operate as an independent business while gaining access to the resources and support of an established leader in the space.

This year, we’re accelerating our roadmap and taking our products to the next level. We’re building new features like mutual funds, bonds, and family investment tools. We’re also exploring how we can leverage AI to deliver an even better experience for our customers.

Freetrade Engineers play a pivotal role in developing and maintaining a robust, scalable platform used by thousands daily. We tackle big technical challenges, drive innovation, and build solutions that make a real impact.

Here, your code doesn’t just run - it powers the decisions of investors across the UK.

About the role

As part of our dedicated mobile engineering team, you will work on implementing new features. In collaboration with design, product and QE teams you will craft user experiences that will delight our customers.

You will also help guide priorities around platform issues, technical debt, patterns, and architecture, ensuring we deliver a high-quality app and an excellent developer experience.

We have recently rebranded key parts of the app, creating a new design system from scratch built with Jetpack Compose, and have started transitioning to a modern, unified GraphQL API using Apollo.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the design and delivery of new features, alongside improving and maintaining the Freetrade Android app, ensuring high performance, quality, security and robustness.

  • Own features end to end, collaborating with backend, design, product and QA to deliver high-quality solutions.

  • Set and hold a high bar for code quality through hands-on development, code reviews and effective testing.

  • Resolve complex issues, address bottlenecks and reduce technical debt.

  • Drive improvements in engineering standards and practices.

  • Mentor and support junior engineers on design, implementation and best practices.

  • Participate in a support rota to understand and resolve customer issues, including direct communication where needed.


About you

  • Typically 6+ years of experience building production-grade mobile applications.

  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to lead technical decisions and deliver complex features.

  • Deep understanding of Android architecture such as MVVM or MVI.

  • Strong experience with Kotlin, Dagger, Jetpack and Compose.

  • Good understanding of GraphQL and integrating with backend services.

  • Experience with coroutines, flow or Rx.

  • Familiarity with git and collaborative development practices.

  • Understanding of CI and build tooling such as CircleCI.

  • Experience mentoring and growing more junior engineers

Our hybrid model

We work from our central London and Budapest offices on Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday, leaving Wednesday and Friday for dedicated focus time at home.

We believe in the power of in-person collaboration to build a strong culture, but we know "life happens." If you have caregiving or personal responsibilities that require extra flexibility, let’s talk about it.

Our interview process

We keep things simple and transparent. You’ll meet one of our Talent Partners for a technical screening call, typically followed by:

  1. Hiring Manager interview

  2. Live coding interview

  3. System design interview

  4. Final Values interview

We are an Equal Opportunity employer committed to a diverse and representative team. Whatever your race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability - we want to hear from you.

To find out more about how we look after your personal data when you apply for a job with us, please see our Recruitment Privacy Policy here.

Please note we are not accepting agency CVs.

description_html:
Operational Trainer
FTC until December 2027
Hellaby (Home of KP Nuts)
On-site

Join our snack-loving team
We’re looking for an Operational Trainer to join us at KP Snacks. If you’re ready to bring your ideas to the table, grow your skills and be part of a team that values what makes you, you – this could be your next big move.

Who are we?
We’re KP Snacks, part of the Intersnack family. Across more than 30 countries, over 15,000 of us work together to make the snacks people love – from Hula Hoops to McCoy’s. In the UK, we’re a team of around 2,400 colleagues, based across seven sites and our Slough HQ. We’re proud of our close-knit culture, where we speak up, celebrate differences and push boundaries together.

About the role

We're looking for an Operational Trainer to join our team and play a key role in developing the skills, knowledge and competence of our colleagues across operational activities.

Reporting into the Site HR Lead, you'll be responsible for delivering high-quality training programmes focused on Material Handling Equipment (MHE), operational processes and safe ways of working. You'll ensure colleagues have the knowledge, confidence and authorisation to carry out their roles safely and effectively, while supporting compliance with business standards and legislative requirements.

Working closely with operational leaders, Health & Safety and the Education & Training (E&T) Pillar, you'll help drive a culture of safety, capability and continuous improvement. From delivering forklift training and conducting competence assessments to developing Job Operating Procedures (JOPs) and supporting colleague development, you'll have a direct impact on operational performance and colleague growth.

What’s in it for you?
We believe in rewarding our colleagues and helping them thrive. Here’s a flavour of what we offer:

  • Competitive annual salary and annual salary review

  • KP Pension Plan with up to 7% matched contributions

  • Annual bonus scheme

  • 25 days holiday, with the option to buy up to five additional days

  • Comprehensive healthcare support including Health Cash Plan, Digital GP and Employee Assistance Programme

  • KP4ME benefits platform with discounts, cashback and wellbeing support

  • Enhanced family-friendly policies to support colleagues at every stage of life

What will you be doing?

  • Delivering operational and MHE training
    Providing accredited and internal training for Material Handling Equipment including Counterbalance, Reach Truck, Powered Pallet Truck, VNA and other authorised equipment, while delivering both practical and classroom-based learning

  • Assessing competence and developing colleagues
    Conducting operator assessments, refresher training, re-certification programmes and coaching colleagues to ensure they operate safely, confidently and effectively

  • Maintaining compliance and training standards
    Managing training records, competence matrices and operator authorisations, while creating and updating training documentation including JOPs, One Point Lessons (OPLs) and job aids

  • Supporting safety and operational excellence
    Promoting safe working practices, supporting battery charging and maintenance activities, working at height training, racking inspections and investigating MHE-related incidents and near misses

  • Driving continuous improvement and capability building
    Partnering with operational leaders, HR and the E&T Pillar to identify skills gaps, deliver development plans and continuously improve training materials, standards and processes


We’d love to hear from you if you can bring:

  • MHE training experience and qualifications
    An accredited Material Handling Equipment (MHE) or Forklift Instructor qualification, along with experience delivering training within a manufacturing, logistics or warehousing environment

  • Health & Safety knowledge and a safety-first mindset
    A good understanding of Health & Safety requirements relating to MHE operations, with a commitment to promoting safe working practices and compliance across the site

  • Strong coaching and communication skills
    Experience delivering training, carrying out competence assessments and coaching colleagues to build confidence, capability and safe working practices

  • Organisation and attention to detail
    The ability to maintain accurate training records, competence matrices and training documentation while managing multiple priorities effectively

  • A passion for developing people
    A genuine interest in helping colleagues learn new skills, improve performance and reach their full potential in a fast-paced operational environment

  • A proactive and professional approach
    Strong problem-solving skills, confidence using Microsoft Office and training management systems, and the ability to work independently while maintaining high standards of quality, safety and compliance

Our purpose
At KP Snacks, we're passionate about creating happy snacking moments through our great tasting snacks and iconic brands. Every day, millions of people enjoy our products, including Hula Hoops, McCoy's, KP Nuts, Tyrrells, Skips, POM-BEAR and Butterkist, making us one of the UK's leading snack manufacturers.

For decades, we've been delighting consumers by combining well-loved favourites with exciting innovations that reflect changing tastes and expectations. We're equally passionate about our people and committed to creating a workplace where everyone can grow, develop and make a real impact.

As part of the Intersnack Group, one of the world's leading snack manufacturers, we combine global expertise with a shared commitment to creating happy snacking moments every day.

We’re committed to inclusion
We’re building a workplace where everyone belongs. If you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you – your unique perspective could be just what we need. And if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you, just let us know.

#LI-SC1 #LI-ONSITE

Job Title: Blockchain / DLT Developer

Location: Ipswich, London or Remote

 

As a Blockchain Developer at MACH, you will play a central role in designing, building, and deploying distributed ledger and smart contract solutions for our financial services clients. You will work across Ethereum, Hedera, Algorand, and MACH Chain (our proprietary blockchain platform) to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performance decentralised applications. Collaborating with cross-functional teams including architects, product managers, and client stakeholders, you will bring deep technical expertise and a proactive approach to solving complex on-chain challenges.


Responsibilities include:

  • Design, develop, and deploy smart contracts and decentralised applications across Ethereum, Hedera, Algorand, and MACH Chain (our proprietary blockchain).

  • Design and implement blockchain-based solutions tailored to the specific requirements of financial services clients.

  • Contribute to the ongoing development and enhancement of MACH Chain, including protocol-level improvements and tooling.

  • Collaborate with backend engineers, solution architects, and product managers to integrate blockchain components with broader platform services and APIs.

  • Conduct rigorous smart contract auditing, testing, and optimisation to ensure security, correctness, and gas efficiency.

  • Stay current with emerging developments across Ethereum (EVM/L2), Hedera Hashgraph, Algorand, and the broader DLT ecosystem.

  • Provide technical guidance and support to junior team members and contribute to internal knowledge sharing.

  • Engage with project managers, product managers and business analysts to understand requirements, present solutions, and support delivery.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of MACH's development processes, standards, and tooling.

 

As an experienced Blockchain Developer, you will have:

  • Experience working specifically with security tokens on distributed ledgers.

  • Proven hands-on experience developing and deploying smart contracts on Ethereum (Solidity) and familiarity with at least one of Hedera (Solidity/Hedera Token Service) or Algorand (PyTEAL/TEAL/ARC standards).

  • Strong understanding of blockchain fundamentals including consensus mechanisms, cryptographic primitives, tokenomics, and DLT architectures.

  • Experience working with Web3 libraries such as Web3.js, Ethers.js, or equivalent SDKs for Hedera and Algorand.

  • Proficiency in one or more backend languages (e.g. Node.js, Python, Go, Java) and RESTful/event-driven API design.

  • Familiarity with blockchain development toolchains including Hardhat, Truffle, Foundry, or equivalent.

  • Experience with version control (Git) and collaborative development workflows.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a rigorous approach to security and edge-case reasoning.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, client-facing environment with competing priorities.

 

Desirable

  • Experience with or exposure to proprietary enterprise blockchain platforms.

  • Knowledge of Layer 2 scaling solutions (e.g. Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism) and cross-chain interoperability protocols.

  • Familiarity with DeFi protocols and token standards (ERC-20, ERC-1400, ERC-3643).

  • Experience in financial services, capital markets, or fintech environments.

  • Understanding of regulatory and compliance considerations relevant to blockchain deployments in financial services.

  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, containerisation (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud infrastructure.

  • Exposure to Agile and DevOps methodologies.

Lead UX/UI Designer

Fixed-term contract, 12 months (maternity cover)

London — hybrid, with regular presence in our London office

Delta Capita is a global provider of managed services, technology and consulting to the financial services industry. Design sits at the centre of how we build our products. Our team shapes the interfaces our clients and their customers use every day.

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Lead UX/UI Designer to cover a 12-month period of maternity leave, starting November 2026 and based in our London office. You will own the design of complex, multi-stakeholder products end to end - from early problem solving through to prototypes and production-ready UI. You’ll work closely with engineering and product teams on a day-to-day basis, with support from senior stakeholders as needed.

You will be comfortable making confident design decisions, shipping in short cycles, and iterating once real feedback arrives.You will be responsible for leading other junior designers in the team, to make help them make decisions, give feedback and make sure work is delivered to a high standard and on time.


Key responsibilities

  • Own complex projects end to end. Take full design accountability for one or more product workstreams, from early discovery through wireframes, prototypes and final UI specification.

  • Design and prototype. Produce interactive prototypes in Sketch to test flows, validate concepts with users and align stakeholders before build.

  • Run and facilitate workshops. Across teams and features, driving strategic alignment.

  • Maintain and evolve the design system. Extend our component library and design standards so that work across the team stays consistent, accessible and reusable.

  • Support junior designers. Set direction, review work, run critique sessions and support the day-to-day development of junior members of the design team.

  • Partner with product and engineering. Work closely with product managers to shape requirements, and with developers to ensure designs are implemented faithfully and are technically feasible.

  • Deliver at pace. Prioritise, break large problems into shippable increments and keep momentum across parallel workstreams.

  • Uphold accessibility and quality. Ensure designs meet WCAG 2.2 AA standards and our internal quality bar before handover.

Essential skills and experience

  • Proven track record as a lead UX/UI designer, with a portfolio demonstrating ownership of complex, large-scale digital products.

  • Advanced working knowledge of Sketch, including symbols, libraries and shared styles.

  • Strong prototyping ability - you can move from a rough concept to a testable interactive prototype quickly.

  • Demonstrable experience mentoring or line-managing junior designers.

  • Confident collaborating with product managers, engineers, business stakeholders and, where relevant, clients.

  • Evidence of delivering high-quality work at pace in an agile environment.

  • Excellent communication skills - you can explain and defend design decisions to non-designers.

  • Right to work in the UK (we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this fixed-term role).

Nice to have

  • Previous experience designing for fintech, banking or another regulated financial services environment.

  • Familiarity with Sketch

  • Exposure to enterprise or B2B products with dense interfaces and complex workflows.

  • Experience running user research and usability testing directly.

title: Senior Meta Ads Specialist | International Ecommerce | Barcelona
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at EnnovationHUB
description_html:
ennovationHUB is a fast-growing international e-commerce group operating in the home & living category, with a strong focus on furniture. From our hubs in Belgrade and London, we serve customers across the UK, North America, EU, and APAC.

As we scale toward €160m+ annual revenue by 2027, we are looking for a Senior Meta Ads Specialist to take ownership of the Meta Ads performance of one of our brands within our portfolio, with direct accountability for growth, efficiency, creative performance, and profitability.

This is not a typical agency paid social role focused on managing a handful of campaigns for different clients. You will be working inside a multi-brand international e-commerce group with significant advertising budgets, multiple markets, and direct visibility into how your work impacts revenue and profitability.

Meta Ads is a core part of our growth strategy. We operate across multiple countries and brands, creating both complexity and opportunity. We are looking for someone who understands performance creative, audience testing, campaign structure, data analysis, and how to scale paid social profitably in a competitive e-commerce environment.

You will work closely with our Head of Performance Marketing, creative team, content team, and data specialists to ensure campaigns are not only performing well today but continue to scale efficiently as the business grows.

What You Will Do

  • Take ownership of Meta Ads performance for one e-commerce brand across multiple international markets

  • Manage and optimise Meta Ads campaigns across Facebook, Instagram, Advantage+ Shopping, retargeting, prospecting, and other relevant campaign types

  • Monitor and improve key performance metrics including ROAS, CPA, conversion rate, revenue, profitability, CTR, CPC, CPM, and creative performance

  • Be directly accountable for growth, efficiency, and performance within your portfolio

  • Identify growth opportunities across products, audiences, markets, creative angles, and customer segments

  • Analyse campaign data and turn insights into actionable recommendations

  • Work closely with creative and content teams to test new concepts, hooks, formats, and ad angles

  • Build structured testing plans for creatives, audiences, landing pages, offers, and campaign setups

  • Conduct account audits and implement ongoing optimisation initiatives

  • Work closely with developers and analytics teams to ensure accurate tracking, attribution, and measurement

  • Support budget planning, forecasting, and performance reporting

  • Stay current with Meta platform developments, AI-driven campaign features, creative best practices, and industry trends

  • Contribute to experimentation frameworks that improve long-term paid social performance

Important Context

You will not be joining a business that is trying to figure out whether Meta Ads works. It already does. Your role is to help us take performance to the next level by identifying opportunities, improving creative testing, improving efficiency, and scaling what works. We operate in a competitive e-commerce environment where small improvements in creative, structure, targeting, or conversion rate can have a significant impact.

You will be working with experienced colleagues who move quickly and care about results. We value people who can think independently, challenge assumptions with data, and take ownership of outcomes. This is not a support role and it is not a reporting role. You will be trusted to make decisions, own results, and have a direct impact on the growth of the business.


This role is strictly for candidates with in-house e-commerce experience. Candidates whose primary Meta Ads experience comes from agencies, consultancies, or freelance work will not be considered.

We are looking for people who have owned performance outcomes inside an e-commerce business, where success is measured by revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, creative performance, and long-term growth rather than client management and campaign delivery. You should have experience working directly within a commercial business and be comfortable taking ownership of results, not simply providing recommendations.

Who You Are

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience managing Meta Ads campaigns

  • Proven hands-on experience managing Meta Ads for an e-commerce business, with direct responsibility for performance and profitability

  • Strong experience with Facebook Ads Manager, Instagram advertising, Advantage+ Shopping campaigns, prospecting, retargeting, and creative testing

  • Proven experience working as part of an in-house e-commerce team rather than as an agency, consultant, or freelancer

  • Strong understanding of paid social creative testing, hooks, angles, formats, and performance analysis

  • Comfortable analysing large datasets and identifying actionable insights

  • Strong understanding of attribution, tracking, and performance measurement

  • Familiarity with Meta Pixel, Conversions API, Google Analytics 4, and campaign reporting tools

  • Highly analytical with strong attention to detail

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities

  • Curious, proactive, and focused on continuous improvement

  • Able to take ownership and make decisions independently

  • We are actively pushing AI and automation across the business, so you need to be comfortable working in that direction and not resistant to change

Profile

  • Senior, but practical

  • Creative-performance minded, not just technical

  • Data-driven without becoming overly theoretical

  • Comfortable taking ownership and making decisions

  • Naturally curious and always looking for performance improvements

  • Focused on outcomes rather than activity

  • Able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution

  • Motivated by building and scaling rather than simply maintaining campaigns

Location & Setup

While this role can be performed remotely within Europe, we are particularly interested in candidates based in Barcelona. We are investing in building a stronger presence there and expect it to become an increasingly important location for our team over time. Our wider team is spread across London, Belgrade, Barcelona, Frankfurt, Oxfordshire, Istanbul, and Guangzhou, with a significant part of the business operating from our Belgrade hub.

The role requires travel approximately every 4–8 weeks to Belgrade, London, or other team locations for planning sessions, workshops, team gatherings, and strategic discussions. While most work is done remotely, we believe that spending time together in person remains valuable, particularly as the company continues to scale.

This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to play a meaningful role in scaling an international e-commerce business over the coming years.

In Our Culture at ennovationHUB We Value

  • Accountability over excuses

  • Execution over talk

  • Clarity over politics

  • Learning through doing

We welcome people from diverse backgrounds. What matters most is doing the work well, taking ownership, and helping the business move forward.

As a strategic advisor to business and HR leaders, this role leverages compensation as a key driver of business performance, enabling growth, strengthening the company's ability to attract and retain top talent, and ensuring competitive market positioning across GTM and international markets. 

This role requires deep expertise in compensation methodologies, sales incentive design, global compensation governance, and international market practices. 


What you'll do:

Compensation Strategy & Program Design 

  • Develop and execute global compensation strategies for GTM and international markets that align with business objectives, growth priorities, and the company's talent philosophy. 
  • Design and oversee compensation programs, including base pay, incentive plans, equity programs, and recognition frameworks, that drive performance, support revenue growth, and address the unique needs of both GTM and internationally based functions. 
  • Lead annual compensation planning, salary review cycles, incentive plan design, and market benchmarking across domestic and international markets to ensure competitive, scalable, and business-aligned programs.

  • Assess country-specific compensation practices, labor market dynamics, regulatory requirements, and competitive positioning to ensure effective and compliant programs across international markets. 
  • Establish scalable global compensation frameworks and governance standards while balancing regional market conditions, business objectives, and local talent strategies. 
  • Provide strategic guidance on international expansion, market entry, and organizational changes by evaluating compensation implications and talent market competitiveness. 

    •  Executive Advisory & Analytics 

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on global compensation strategy, international talent investments and evolving labor market trends. 
  • Deliver data-driven insights and recommendations using Radford benchmarks, market intelligence, and internal analytics to support compensation decisions across GTM and international functions. 
  • Provide strategic guidance on compensation-related risks, opportunities, workforce investments, and global talent competitiveness. 
  • Influence business decisions related to international growth, talent mobility, and organizational expansion through compensation expertise and market insights.  

    • Governance, Compliance & Pay Equity 

  • Ensure compensation programs comply with applicable regulatory requirements, pay transparency legislation, and governance standards across all countries and regions in which the company operates. 
  • Establish and maintain robust global compensation governance frameworks, policies, and controls that promote consistency, scalability, and sound decision-making while addressing local market requirements. 
  • Lead global pay equity analyses and remediation efforts to support fair, competitive, and equitable compensation practices across diverse employee populations. 
  • Monitor emerging regulatory developments and compensation trends globally, proactively recommending program and policy enhancements as needed. 

    • Required qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Finance, Business, Economics, or related field.  
  • 15+ years of progressive compensation experience.

Für ein international aufgestelltes Unternehmen mit langfristiger, familiengeprägter Unternehmenskultur suchen wir einen erfahrenen Manager SAP Basis Solutions (m/w/d) am Standort Mannheim.

Die SAP-Landschaft umfasst SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA sowie moderne SAP-Plattformen und befindet sich in einer kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung hin zu einer stärker integrierten, sicheren und zukunftsfähigen Systemlandschaft.

**Die Position richtet sich an jemanden, der über die klassische Administration hinaus Verantwortung übernehmen möchte, für Stabilität, Sicherheit, Performance, Automatisierung und technologische Weiterentwicklung.
**

Aufgaben

Was macht diese Position besonders?

Sie verantworten nicht einfach ein einzelnes SAP-System.

Sie arbeiten in einer globalen und sich weiterentwickelnden SAP-Plattformlandschaft und verbinden operativen Betrieb mit Technologie, Transformation und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung.

Ihre Aufgaben umfassen:

  • Sicherstellung des stabilen, sicheren und performanten Betriebs der globalen SAP-Systemlandschaft inklusive SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA und weiterer SAP-Plattformen
  • Operative SAP-Basisadministration mit Schwerpunkt auf Systemmonitoring, Transport-, Job-, Druck- und Schnittstellenmanagement sowie Performanceanalyse und Troubleshooting
  • Planung und technische Umsetzung von Upgrades, Releasewechseln, Migrationen, Systemkopien, Templates und internationalen Rollout-Projekten

  • Koordination und fachliche Steuerung externer Dienstleister, Hosting-Provider und SAP-Berater sowie Sicherstellung der vereinbarten Servicequalität
  • Technische Begleitung von SAP-Systemvermessungen sowie Analyse der SAP-Lizenznutzung zur Identifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen
  • Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung und Automatisierung der SAP-Betriebsprozesse mit Fokus auf Verfügbarkeit, Security, Compliance, Performance und Zukunftsfähigkeit

Kurz gesagt:

Sie sorgen nicht nur dafür, dass die SAP-Landschaft heute funktioniert.
Sie helfen dabei, sie für morgen besser, sicherer und automatisierter zu machen.

Qualifikation

Was sollten Sie mitbringen?

Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit mit fundierter SAP-Basis-Expertise und Interesse an modernen SAP-Technologien.

Sie bringen idealerweise mit:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung
  • Praktische Erfahrung in der SAP-Basisadministration sowie im Betrieb komplexer SAP-ECC- und SAP-S/4HANA-Systemlandschaften
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in SAP NetWeaver und SAP HANA, insbesondere in Monitoring, Transportmanagement, Systemkopien, Upgrades, Migrationen und Troubleshooting
  • Erfahrung mit hybriden SAP-Landschaften sowie modernen SAP-Technologien wie SAP BTP und SAP Cloud ALM; Kenntnisse in SAP RISE Private Cloud Edition sind von Vorteil
  • Kenntnisse in SAP Security, Rollen und Berechtigungen, Zertifikatsmanagement, Hochverfügbarkeit sowie Backup- und Disaster-Recovery-Konzepten
  • Erfahrung mit technischer SAP-Systemvermessung und der Bewertung der Lizenznutzung
  • Erfahrung in der Koordination und fachlichen Steuerung externer Service Provider
  • Eine selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Sie müssen nicht jede einzelne Technologie perfekt beherrschen.

**Wenn Sie eine solide SAP-Basis-Expertise mitbringen und Lust darauf haben, sich in eine moderne, international ausgerichtete SAP-Plattformlandschaft weiterzuentwickeln, freuen wir uns ebenfalls auf Ihre Kontaktaufnahme.
**

Benefits

Was erwartet Sie?

Sie arbeiten in einem global agierenden Unternehmen, das internationale Größe mit der langfristigen Orientierung eines familiengeprägten Geschäftsmodells verbindet.

Freuen Sie sich auf:

  • Einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag
  • Ein attraktives Gehaltspaket inklusive Unternehmenserfolgsbeteiligung
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • 2 Tage Homeoffice pro Woche

  • Individuelle Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten und umfangreiche Online-Lernangebote über einen eigenen LearningHub
  • Eine moderne Arbeitsumgebung

description_html:
Du hast Freude daran, technische Probleme zu lösen, behältst auch bei mehreren offenen Themen den Überblick und kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich erklären?

Dann könnte diese Rolle gut zu dir passen.

Bei eHealth-Connect entwickeln wir digitale Lösungen für die vernetzte Gesundheitsversorgung. Unsere Produkte werden von unterschiedlichen Akteuren im Gesundheitswesen genutzt – und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Du bist eine wichtige Ansprechperson für unsere Kund:innen, wenn Fragen entstehen, Prozesse nicht wie erwartet laufen oder technische Unterstützung benötigt wird.

Dabei geht es bei uns nicht um klassischen Callcenter-Support, sondern darum, Probleme wirklich zu verstehen, strukturiert einzugrenzen und gemeinsam mit unseren technischen Teams Lösungen zu finden.

Warum brauchen wir diese Rolle?

Mit unseren Produkten, Kunden und Anwendungsfällen wächst auch die Zahl der Themen, die im täglichen Betrieb schnell und zuverlässig gelöst werden müssen. Deshalb möchten wir unseren Support weiter professionalisieren und suchen jemanden, der Supportfälle strukturiert übernimmt, technische Zusammenhänge analysiert und dafür sorgt, dass unsere Kund:innen schnell die richtige Unterstützung bekommen. Gleichzeitig bist du eine wichtige Schnittstelle zu unseren technischen und fachlichen Teams: Du erkennst wiederkehrende Fehlerbilder, bereitest komplexere Fälle sauber auf und hilfst damit auch uns, unsere Produkte und Prozesse kontinuierlich besser zu machen.

Warum ist die Rolle spannend?

Du bearbeitest bei uns nicht einfach Tickets nach Schema F.

Unsere Lösungen bewegen sich in einem technisch anspruchsvollen Umfeld und verbinden Software, unterschiedliche Systeme, Schnittstellen und Prozesse im Gesundheitswesen miteinander. Das bedeutet: Hinter einer Supportanfrage steckt manchmal eine einfache Bedienfrage – manchmal aber auch ein technisches Puzzle. Du lernst unsere Produkte und Systeme sehr genau kennen, arbeitest eng mit Entwicklung, Deployment und Fachbereichen zusammen und entwickelst mit der Zeit ein gutes Gespür dafür, wo ein Problem entsteht und wie wir es am besten lösen können.

Aufgaben

Was sind deine Aufgaben?

  • Annahme, Erfassung und Bearbeitung von Supportanfragen unserer Kund:innen
  • Unterstützung der Anwender:innen bei Fragen zur Bedienung und zu den Prozessen unserer Produkte
  • Analyse und erste Eingrenzung technischer und fachlicher Fehler
  • Prüfung von Fehlermeldungen, Prozessstatus, Logs und vorhandenen Systeminformationen
  • Klassifizierung und Priorisierung von Supportfällen sowie Überwachung vereinbarter Service Levels
  • Lösung bekannter Störungen anhand vorhandener Dokumentationen und Workarounds
  • Qualifizierte Eskalation komplexerer Fälle an 2nd Level, Entwicklung oder zuständige Fachbereiche
  • Nachvollziehbare Dokumentation von Lösungen und wiederkehrenden Fehlerbildern in unserer Wissensdatenbank

Qualifikation

Was hilft dir, in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein?

Kenntnisse im Apotheken-, Pharma- oder Gesundheitswesen sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Wichtig ist uns vor allem, dass du gerne Probleme löst, strukturiert arbeitest und Freude an der Kommunikation mit Menschen hast.

  • Erfahrung im IT-Support, Service Desk oder technischen Kundensupport ist von Vorteil
  • Gutes technisches Verständnis sowie eine strukturierte und analytische Arbeitsweise
  • Erfahrung mit Ticketsystemen sowie im Umgang mit Fehlermeldungen und Logs
  • Hohe Kunden- und Serviceorientierung sowie eine klare, freundliche und verbindliche Kommunikation

title: Senior Data Scientist (m/f/x)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Makersite GmbH
description_html:
Data Scientist (m/f/x) 

Location: EU

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Data Scientists who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. Ifyou're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:  

Develop and Deploy Production-Grade AI Systems 

  • Build, deploy, and maintain scalable APIs that serve AI/ML models in production environments 

  • Own end-to-end delivery of AI solutions, from prototyping to fully productionized systems 

Design Advanced AI Architectures 

  • Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using vector databases 

  • Build and orchestrate AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Evaluate and select appropriate large language models (LLMs) and foundation models based on specific use cases 

Optimize Performance and Scalability 

  • Continuously optimize model inference for latency, cost efficiency, and throughput at scale 

  • Identify bottlenecks and implement improvements to ensure high-performing systems 

Ensure Reliability and Observability 

  • Implement robust monitoring, logging, and alerting for deployed models and services 

  • Ensure system reliability, uptime, and performance through best practices in production ML systems 

Establish Engineering Best Practices 

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for seamless testing, deployment, and iteration of AI systems 

  • Contribute to evolving engineering standards as the company transitions from rapid experimentation to more structured, scalable operations 

Collaborate Cross-Functionally 

  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into core products 

  • Translate business problems into technical solutions and clearly communicate trade-offs 

Drive Structure in a Fast-Paced Environment 

  • Help bring stability and structure to AI development processes during a high-growth, scale-up phase 

  • Balance speed of execution with the need for maintainable, well-documented, and scalable systems 

  • Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them through to practical, production-ready outcomes 


Core Experience 

  • 5+ years of experience in Python, with ~10 years of overall software engineering or data experience (candidates transitioning from backend engineering are welcome) 

  • Proven experience building and deploying production-grade APIs (preferably with FastAPI; REST/GraphQL experience is a plus) 

  • Hands-on experience working with large language models (LLMs) and LLMOps, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation (e.g., GPT, Claude) 

  • Strong experience fine-tuning open-source models (e.g., Hugging Face ecosystem) 

  • Practical experience designing and working with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, pgvector) 

  • Experience building AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Solid understanding of model deployment and serving (e.g., vLLM, TGI, or managed endpoints) 

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices (Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions) 

  • Strong experience working with and processing large-scale text datasets 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience with MLOps platforms such as MLflow or Weights & Biases 

  • Familiarity with cloud AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI) 

  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects 

  • Experience in the sustainability or climate/product domain 

  • Background in B2B SaaS environments 

  • Prior experience in a startup or scale-up environment (approximately 100–300 employees) 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

Key Attributes 

  • Builder mindset: Comfortable owning systems end-to-end, from experimentation through to production 

  • Bias for action: Operates effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting priorities 

  • Systems thinker: Designs solutions with scalability, reliability, and maintainability in mind 

  • Pragmatic decision-making: Balances technical excellence with speed and business impact 

  • Ownership & accountability: Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs 

  • Clear communicator: Able to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. 

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here 

  

Diversity and Inclusion 

If you have a medical condition or an individual need for an adjustment to our process, and you believe this may affect your ability to be at your best – please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support you and make any adjustments that may be needed.  

 

At Makersite, we are dedicated to fostering an environment that champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will consider all applications regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, nationality, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rest assured, all applications will be handled with the utmost confidentiality.

title: ERP Rollout Project Manager – Manufacturing & Supply Chain
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Intersnack IT KG
description_html:
We want you to grow with us 

We are expanding our international IT organisation and looking for an ERP Rollout Project Manager – Manufacturing & Supply Chain to join our cross-functional IT Project and Portfolio Management Team. In this role, you will manage IT delivery within ERP implementation and rollout projects across multiple functions, sites and countries. As part of the wider rollout team, you will ensure that technical, infrastructure and operational activities are planned and aligned with the overall ERP rollout. You will combine strong IT project management capabilities with a solid understanding of ERP environments and the technology dependencies required to successfully deploy them within manufacturing operations. Your work will help modernise our systems, harmonise processes and deploy new capabilities across our European operations.

Please note: This role may require travel to Intersnack locations and project offices up to 30–40% of the time.

What we can offer 

You will have the opportunity to manage IT delivery across the lifecycle of international ERP rollout projects, from planning and mobilisation through testing, deployment, cutover, go-live and stabilisation.

Working closely with business teams, IT specialists, local sites and external partners, you will operate at the intersection of ERP, business processes and site technology. This includes ensuring that infrastructure, devices, access and other technical dependencies are ready to support manufacturing, supply chain and logistics operations.

How you will spend your time as our next ERP Rollout Project Manager 

As our next ERP Rollout Project Manager – Manufacturing & Supply Chain (internal title: IT Project Manager), you will manage ERP-related projects within the IT area as part of the overall rollout team. You will own the IT project plan, coordinate the relevant workstreams and ensure that milestones, dependencies, risks and deliverables remain aligned with the wider rollout.

  • Manage IT delivery within ERP implementation and rollout projects from planning through go-live, stabilisation and transition to support 

  • Own and maintain the IT project plan, ensuring alignment with the wider ERP rollout and its business and functional workstreams 

  • Coordinate internal IT teams, business stakeholders, local sites, external implementation partners and service providers 

  • Translate rollout requirements into clear project activities, milestones, dependencies and deliverables 

  • Ensure infrastructure and site technology requirements are incorporated into the rollout plan, including connectivity, user access, handheld devices, scanners and printers 

  • Coordinate testing, deployment, site readiness, cutover and go-live activities within the assigned IT scope 

  • Manage project scope, timelines, resources, budgets, risks, issues and dependencies, including appropriate reporting and escalation

  • Support business readiness, training coordination and post-go-live stabilisation together with the wider rollout team

  • Apply established project management standards and contribute to continuous improvement of project delivery across the portfolio


What we expect from you 

  • Several years of experience managing complex IT projects, including experience within an end-to-end ERP implementation or rollout

  • Ideally, experience with ERP rollouts across multiple sites, countries or business units within an international organisation

  • A solid high-level understanding of ERP systems, including how modules, integrations and business processes interact

  • Good understanding of manufacturing, supply chain and logistics processes, ideally gained within food, FMCG, process manufacturing or a comparable industry

  • Understanding of the wider technology dependencies involved in ERP rollouts, including infrastructure, connectivity, access, devices and integrations

  • Experience coordinating testing, deployment, cutover, go-live and post-implementation activities

  • Strong project planning, stakeholder management, risk management and problem-solving capabilities across cross-functional and geographically distributed teams

  • A structured, hands-on and solution-focused approach with the ability to operate effectively within a complex matrix organisation

  • Project management certification such as PRINCE2 Practitioner, PMP or APM PPQ is desirable, alongside good working knowledge of common project management and reporting tools

  • A strong command of spoken and written English is essential; knowledge of German is an advantage


Important: Applicants must have the legal right to work in Germany. Please note that visa or work-permit sponsorship is not available for this position.

About Intersnack IT:

Intersnack IT KG is a member of the Pfeifer & Langen Industrie- und Handels-KG’s group of companies and a sister company to Intersnack Group. Established from the international harmonization and centralization of Intersnack Group’s IT estate, we are responsible for all group-wide IT services for and within Intersnack Group. Our goal is to provide a common IT infrastructure, aligned IT services, and business solutions according to Intersnack’s requirements. Based on a solid digital foundation, Intersnack IT KG acts as a partner to all Intersnack functions, actively contributing to Intersnack’s business strategy. Explore exciting career opportunities and learn more by visiting our website at Intersnack IT KG.

About Intersnack Group:

Intersnack has become one of Europe’s leading savory snacks producers by ‘creating happy snacking moments’ in people’s lives. Being privately owned, we operate with a long-term view and commit ourselves to a more sustainable world. Successfully and sustainably growing, our turnover in 2024 was more than €4.5 bn. We are now present in more than 30 countries across Europe and beyond. We have 12 regional Management Units, 45 production sites, and a total workforce of approximately 15,000 people worldwide. For further company insights, please visit the following link: Intersnack Group Overview

If you want to be part of our dynamic food industry success story, you’ll find all sorts of opportunities at Intersnack. Join our team, help us grow, and celebrate our successes together!

description_html:
Wir schaffen bleibende Erinnerungen durch wunderschöne Papeterie- und Fotoprodukte.

Die kartenmacherei, Teil der celebrate company, ist der führende E-Commerce-Anbieter für schöne und individuelle Papeterieprodukte in der DACH-Region. Mit unseren schnellwachsenden Marken faireparterie und Atelier Rosemood begeistern wir unsere Kund:innen auch im französischen Markt mit hochwertigen und liebevoll gefertigten Karten, Fotobüchern und Fotokalendern.

Wir suchen eine:n Senior Performance / Growth Marketing Manager:in (m/w/d), der/die als dedizierte:r Marketing-Owner:in ein neues digitales B2C-Produkt innerhalb der celebrate company von Grund auf mit aufbaut. Du vereinst Paid Acquisition, Landingpage-Optimierung, CRM und Customer Research zu einer ganzheitlichen Growth Engine – mit einem konsequenten AI-first-Ansatz in deiner Arbeitsweise. Die Rolle ist in einem kleinen, autonomen, crossfunktionalen Team angesiedelt, berichtet in die CMO-Organisation und ist remote innerhalb der GSA-Region möglich.

Das jährliche Gehalt für diese Position liegt bei 58.900-80.000€ (Senior) / 76.000-114.600€ (Principal).

Deine Rolle

  • End-to-End-Verantwortung für alle Marketingaktivitäten – von Paid Acquisition (Meta) über die Erstellung und Optimierung von Landingpages bis hin zu CRM- und Lifecycle-Kampagnen

  • Customer Research durch regelmäßige Interviews und qualitatives Feedback zur Schärfung von Produktpositionierung, Messaging und Wachstumsprioritäten in einer sehr frühen Beta-Phase

  • Kontinuierliche Growth-Experimente über neue Kanäle, Kreativformate und AI-gestützte Workflows hinweg, mit voller Verantwortung für Marketing-KPIs wie Cost per Install, Funnel Conversion und Aktivierungsraten

  • Marketing-Performance-Reporting und Budgetsteuerung inklusive Kampagnenanalyse, Forecasting und datenbasierter Empfehlungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Product & Business Lead, der CMO und dem Gründer

Deine Benefits

  • Wir schätzen Flexibilität: Flexible Remote-Arbeit, Teilzeitoptionen, moderne Hardware (Macbooks), kollaborative Büroflächen (Flex Desks)

  • Wir begrüßen New Work: Agile Arbeitsweise, Fair Pay, Kompetenz- und Führungsmodelle

  • Wir möchten, dass es dir gut geht: Nilo.health, Corporate Benefits, JobRad, Workations, Sabbaticals, 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub sowie dein persönliches Benefit nach Wahl: Wellpass, Hansefit oder das DB-Jobticket

  • Wir wollen mit dir wachsen: Interne Weiterbildung, Coaching, regelmäßige Feedback- und Wachstumsprozesse, flexible externe Lernmöglichkeiten

  • Wir sind ein Team: Office-Frühstück und Lunch, (freiwillige) Events, Remote Team-Building, Office Dogs, und exklusive Family & Friends-Rabatte


Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige, praktische Growth-Marketing-Erfahrung für ein digitales B2C-Produkt in einem schnelllebigen Startup- oder Scale-up-Umfeld, idealerweise als Founding Marketer oder erste:r Marketing-Mitarbeiter:in

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Steuerung und Optimierung von Paid-Social-Kampagnen (insbesondere Meta) sowie CRM-/Lifecycle-Kampagnen, gepaart mit starken analytischen Fähigkeiten und einem natürlichen Gespür für Marke und visuelles Storytelling. Vertrautheit mit Product-Analytics-Tools wie Amplitude

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf Muttersprachniveau und fließendes Englisch; Erfahrung mit App Marketing, Influencer Marketing oder SEA ist ein Plus

Dein Mindset

  • AI-first – Du suchst aktiv nach AI-Tools und -Agents, um deine Arbeit zu beschleunigen, und es motiviert dich, Marketing-Workflows aufzubauen, in denen AI ein zentraler Bestandteil ist – kein Nachgedanke

  • Hands-on – Du fühlst dich als alleinige:r Marketing-Owner:in wohl, bewegst dich schnell von der Hypothese zur Live-Kampagne und baust Landingpages, erstellst Ads und ziehst Performance-Daten selbst

  • Experimentierfreudig – Du bevorzugst zehn kleine Tests gegenüber einem großen Launch, misst alles gegen klare Hypothesen und nutzt Daten, um zu entscheiden, was skaliert und was gestoppt wird

Über celebrate company 

celebrate company ist eine Gruppe aus sechs Marken: Atelier Rosemood, celebrate apps, celebrate digital printing, faireparterie, kartenmacherei und mintkind. Gemeinsam betreiben wir E-Commerce-Shops, Produktionsstätten und weitere digitale Services in ganz Europa, die alle dasselbe Ziel haben: bedeutende Momente in wunderschöne Erinnerungen zu verwandeln. Unsere Kultur basiert auf einem Growth Mindset, offenem Feedback und Flexibilität. So übernehmen wir Verantwortung, testen mutig Neues und entwickeln uns gemeinsam weiter.

title: Data Platform Engineer (m/w/d)

description_html:
Du möchtest nicht nur Daten verarbeiten, sondern eine moderne Datenplattform entwickeln, die Analysen, Reporting und datengetriebene Entscheidungen im gesamten Unternehmen ermöglicht? 

Dann könnte diese Position genau das Richtige für dich sein. 

Unser Kunde, ein dynamisch wachsende E-Commerce Service Agentur in Berlin, zählt zu den erfolgreichsten Amazon-Händlern Deutschlands und vertreibt tausende Produkte 

Für den weiteren Ausbau der Data & Analytics Landschaft wird eine Persönlichkeit gesucht, die moderne Datenarchitekturen entwickelt und den Weg zu einer datengetriebenen Organisation aktiv mitgestaltet 

Deine Benefits

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Ein leistungsgerechtes Fixgehalt, das deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation entspricht.  

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit 2 Home-Office Tagen, einer 40-Stunden-Woche, Gleitzeit mit Arbeitsbeginn zwischen 6:00 und 10:00 Uhr.  

  • Langfristige Sicherheit: Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag sowie 30 Urlaubstage in einem wirtschaftlich erfolgreichen und zukunftssicheren Unternehmen.  

  • Weiterentwicklung: Ob fachlich oder persönlich – deine Entwicklung wird aktiv gefördert und langfristig begleitet.  

  • Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Freue dich auf ein modernes Büro im Berliner Bezirk Lichtenberg.  

  • Mobilität: Ob mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln oder dem Auto – profitiere von einem bezuschussten Jobticket oder kostenlosen Parkplätzen direkt am Büro.  

  • Teamkultur: Flache Hierarchien, offene Kommunikation, eine gelebte Du-Kultur und regelmäßige Team- sowie Firmenevents wie „Grill & Chill“ sorgen für ein starkes Miteinander.  

  • Verpflegung: Kostenlose Getränke sowie frisches Obst stehen dir im Arbeitsalltag jederzeit zur Verfügung.  

  • Mitarbeitervorteile: Profitiere von attraktiven Mitarbeiterrabatten auf das Sortiment sowie weiteren Corporate Benefits. 

Deine Aufgaben

Als Data Engineer entwickelst und betreibst du moderne Datenplattformen in Microsoft Azure und Microsoft Fabric und sorgst dafür, dass hochwertige Daten zuverlässig für Analysen, Reporting und Machine-Learning-Anwendungen bereitstehen. 

  • Data Engineering: Konzeption, Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung moderner Datenpipelines in Microsoft Azure und Microsoft Fabric.  

  • Datenqualität: Sicherstellung einer hohen Datenqualität, Vollständigkeit und Reproduzierbarkeit sowie Implementierung effizienter inkrementeller Datenladeprozesse.  

  • Datenintegration: Entwicklung und Pflege effizienter ETL-/ELT-Prozesse sowie API-basierter Datenintegrationen.  

  • Plattformbetrieb: Entwicklung robuster Monitoring-, Logging- und Fehlerbehandlungskonzepte sowie kontinuierliche Optimierung von Performance, Kosten und Datenworkflows.  

  • Data Architecture: Mitarbeit am Aufbau einer skalierbaren Datenarchitektur inklusive Test-, Staging- und Produktionsumgebungen sowie moderner Technologien wie CI/CD, Fabric Pipelines, dbt oder Airflow.  

  • Zusammenarbeit: Enge Abstimmung mit dem Head of Data & Analytics und den Data Analysts zur Bereitstellung hochwertiger Daten für Power BI Dashboards und Machine-Learning-Modelle. 

Dein Profil als Data Engineer

  • Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb von Datenpipelines oder Datenplattformen – idealerweise auf Senior-Level, motivierte Mid-Level-Profile sind ebenfalls willkommen.  

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Azure Data Services, insbesondere Data Factory und/oder Azure Synapse; idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung mit Microsoft Fabric.  

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL und Python, insbesondere im Bereich ETL-/ELT-Prozesse und Automatisierung.  

  • Erfahrung in der Datenmodellierung, idealerweise mit Bronze-, Silver- und Gold-Layer-Architekturen.  

  • Kenntnisse im Datenqualitätsmanagement sowie in Monitoring, Logging und Performance-Optimierung.  

  • Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Umsetzung technischer Projekte sowie eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.  

  • Ausgeprägte Teamorientierung sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld.  

  • Fließende Deutsch- oder Englischkenntnisse. Bei geringeren Deutschkenntnissen (ab B1) werden dafür sehr gute Englischkenntnisse vorausgesetzt.  

Nice-to-haves – jedes zusätzliche Know-how ist ein Pluspunkt:

  • Erfahrung mit inkrementellen Ladeprozessen und Delta-Verarbeitung.  

  • Erfahrung in der Datenintegration für Power BI sowie im Umgang mit semantischen Modellen.  

  • Kenntnisse im E-Commerce- oder Amazon-Umfeld.  

  • Erfahrung mit API-basierten Datenintegrationen.  

  • Kenntnisse in CI/CD, z. B. mit GitHub Actions oder Azure DevOps.
